verdict: Ready to merge within the targeted findings 3-6 scope

scope.description: Seven backend files in ea1f53c plus four working-tree settings screens and two explicitly included untracked settings-requests browser specs.

intent: Verify that reset contracts include confirmation, Inertia conceals reset-delivery failures, passkey reads reject stale responses, and recovery rotation invalidates displayed codes before replacement retrieval.

evidence: template/stacks/api-next/services/api/Modules/Identity/Support/AccountOperationTransformer.php:31 defines all four reset credentials; object() at line 118 marks each required.
template/stacks/api-next/packages/api-client/openapi.json:884 requires password_confirmation and src/schema.d.ts:1235 exposes it as a required string.
template/stacks/api-next/services/api/Modules/Identity/Tests/Http/AccountSchemaTest.php:30 generates a fresh schema and checks required fields, property types and email format.

template/stacks/api-next/apps/web/components/screens/passkeys.tsx:34-53 uses the same generation-guarded loader for reads and rejects both stale success and stale failure. Cleanup increments the generation.
template/stacks/inertia-monolith/resources/js/pages/settings/passkeys.tsx:33-52 has the equivalent guard. Retry, enrollment refresh and removal refresh all call that loader.
Both e2e/settings-requests.spec.ts files hold the initial response until enrollment refresh has rendered the new key, then release either 200 or 503 and assert the key remains with no retry error.

template/stacks/api-next/apps/web/components/screens/recovery.tsx:109-116 clears codes immediately after successful POST, marks them invalidated, and only clears that marker after GET succeeds. Copy is disabled at line 84 while an operation is pending.
template/stacks/inertia-monolith/resources/js/pages/settings/recovery.tsx:100-104 implements equivalent invalidation. Its read-only retry is at lines 63-69.

API browser spec lines 87-130 and Inertia lines 88-133 defer POST and replacement GET, verify Copy is disabled, verify old codes disappear before GET completes, fail GET, then retry and assert one POST and three GETs total.

template/stacks/inertia-monolith/app/Http/Controllers/Users/PasswordResetLinkController.php:16-28 retains Fortify request validation and username normalization, reports broker exceptions, and returns the generic response.

template/stacks/inertia-monolith/routes/auth.php:16 replaces only the existing named route action, preserving vendor middleware. PasswordResetLinkResponse.php:17-21 returns the same JSON message or HTML flash response.

template/stacks/inertia-monolith/tests/Http/Users/AuthenticationTest.php:92-115 tests thrown delivery for known uppercase and unknown addresses in JSON and HTML, verifies reporting and token creation. Lines 117-129 cover retained throttling and CSRF. Existing lines 68-89 cover validation and normal reset behavior.
